snapshot.title: Fix mission debrief showing no returned mission after successful return
snapshot.description: After a mission is launched from Earth, mines, and returns home, mission debrief incorrectly shows 'no returned mission found'. This indicates mission return/debrief state is not persisted or queried correctly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: After a completed launch-mine-return flow, mission debrief displays the returned mission instead of 'no returned mission found'
Returned mission lookup is resilient to scene transitions/reloads
Regression is covered by an automated test or deterministic reproduction check
